summary: PrqOccupationalHealth is a Staff Profile user control for managing Occupational Health prerequisites, requirements, immunization statuses, and medical completion for staff members in an institutional setting. It displays and edits summarized and detailed health-related prerequisites including immunization, medical tests, and serology, supporting multilingual descriptions and UI behaviors. The control orchestrates workflows for loading, displaying, editing, and validating occupational health data and integrates with calendar controls and dropdowns for data entry and management.
purpose: To allow staff administrators and related users to review, update, and validate occupational health and immunization requirements of staff, including both summary and detailed medical prerequisites and test results. It ensures compliance with health prerequisites and tracks completion dates, statuses, notes, and fee payments.

business_rules: Immunization and medical prerequisites must be tracked per staff.
Requirements and completion status can be set as 'Pending', 'Complete', or other codes.
Language-specific descriptions provided if 'UseAltLanguageFields' is enabled.
All dropdown selections must have corresponding IDs and source codes.
Fee payment tracking is linked to ImmunizationFeePaid flag and date.
Certain panels and controls are hidden or disabled if not editable or inactive.
validations: Cancel update if page is not valid.
Dropdowns and checkboxes must be set for each prerequisite and source code.
Date controls disabled if not editable.
Data updated only if valid and session present.
calculations: ImmunReqMetDate and MedicalCompletedDate are formatted for display.
Admin dates for shots, tests, and serology are formatted and displayed.
Flu season year calculation for influenza administration dates.
conditions: If Inactive, edit buttons are hidden.
If ScreenIsEditable, edit icons and tooltips are set.
If Disabled or not editable, calendar and edit fields are disabled.
If UseAltLanguageFields is true, show alternative descriptions.
system_behavior: Panels load summary and detailed prerequisite info.
Switches to edit mode for grid upon edit button click.
Updates fields based on dropdown selections.
dependencies: Dropdown and calendar controls for field entry.
ObjectDataSource bindings for status codes and sources.
ScriptManager for JavaScript registration and async postbacks.
exceptions: Update is cancelled if page is not valid.
Selecting code or data fails if session is null.
content_gaps: No business logic or field definitions for StudentPrerequisite entity are directly present.
Data structure and validation logic for medical/compliance status codes are inferred from UI, not fully explicit in documents.
No descriptive workflow documentation for edge cases or exception handling policies.
No external integration or API details present.
